subject: Oceanography
title: Ocean Heat Content
description: A 60-second lesson on Ocean Heat Content.

hook.text: Scientists measure ocean warming not by temperature alone—but by total heat content in joules.

buildup.text: A tiny 0.1°C rise across the whole ocean represents an enormous amount of energy.

discovery.text: The Argo float network (4,000+ robots) profiles ocean temperature to 2,000 m depth worldwide.

twist.text: Deep water below 2,000 m is also warming—but we have far fewer measurements there.

climax.text: Ocean heat content hit record highs every year from 2020 to 2024—each year warmer than the last.

punchline.text: Thousands of robots track an ocean growing warmer by the year.

quiz.question: What is the Argo network?
options: A fleet of 4,000+ floats measuring ocean temperature
A network of buoys on the surface only
